user_prompt: For Apple Inc.'s FY2024 10-K, does the record support the claim that Apple's FY2024 revenue meets or exceeds $350,000,000,000?
scope: The single embedded REAL SEC XBRL record AAPL-RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax-FY2024 (top-level records.AAPL-RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax-FY2024 of this instance file), fetched verbatim via bench/fetch_edgar.py from https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK0000320193.json (PROVENANCE in artifacts/fin-aapl/PROVENANCE, full untrimmed concept history in artifacts/fin-aapl/companyfacts_trimmed.json; this instance embeds the SAME fields SEC reported, restructured from SEC's own list-of-annual-entries shape into flat named keys so every field is addressed by a plain dotted name, never a numeric list index), read exclusively via inspect_record(record_id='AAPL-RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax-FY2024', field_path=...): entityName (filer identity), annual.val/fy/fp/form/concept (the single embedded FY2024 annual (Form 10-K) RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax figure, as SEC's own structured filer disclosure reports it). The verdict is scoped to this ONE record's own declared XBRL fields only -- no external market-data lookup, analyst estimate, or human/LLM judgment is used or available; every atom is a closed, mechanically-decidable Boolean predicate over the record (prime_runtime/predicates.py).

claims.text: The record's filer identity and the existence of a reported RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax figure for FY2024 are located in the supplied record.
The identifying/existence facts are established (C1) and the record's RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax figure for FY2024 is confirmed to equal exactly $391,035,000,000.

Under the supplied record, RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax ($391,035,000,000) meets or exceeds the large-cap revenue threshold of $350,000,000,000: the record supports the claim that Apple's FY2024 revenue meets or exceeds $350,000,000,000.

atoms.proposition: The record's filer identity is read via inspect_record(field_path='entityName') and found present.
The record's RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax figure for FY2024 is read via inspect_record(field_path='annual.val') and found present.
The same RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax figure is read again and found to equal exactly $391,035,000,000 (the record's own reported value, verbatim from SEC's XBRL data).
The same RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax figure is read a third time and found to meet or exceed the large-cap revenue threshold $350,000,000,000.

Non-route background: the filing form type backing this figure is read via inspect_record(field_path='annual.form') and found to be '10-K' (an audited annual report) -- not required for, and not evidence toward, the Apple's FY2024 revenue meets or exceeds $350,000,000,000 claim.
